tools.open.label: Groom Tools
tools.open.tip: Brushes, guide groups, painted maps and sculpt layers

graph.open.label: Graph Editor
graph.open.tip: The look: the groom's node graph

groom.create.label: Create Groom from Selection
groom.create.tip: Selected mesh becomes the scalp; selected curves become guides (an untitled scene goes on: its files move beside it when it is saved)

sample.nika.label: Nika (head)
sample.nika.tip: Nika, a head and shoulders, at the origin and selected: then Create Groom from Selection

sample.manny.label: Manny (head)
sample.manny.tip: Manny, a head, at the origin and selected: then Create Groom from Selection

sample.wolf.label: Wolf
sample.wolf.tip: A sitting wolf (body, eyes, nails, mouth), at the origin, its body selected: then Create Groom from Selection

photos.guides.label: Guides from Photos (experimental)...
photos.guides.tip: Grow guides from reference photos: the photo and the mesh side by side, a few landmarks to line the camera up, optional flow arrows and mask touch-ups, Generate

file.import.label: Import Groom File...
file.import.tip: A groom from a .groom file (exported from Maya or saved by the standalone app), on the selected mesh when it is the file's scalp, else on a mesh made from the file

file.reload.label: Reload from Groom File
file.reload.tip: Replace the groom's graph, guides, correctives and maps with its groom file's (the standalone app's edits), keeping the node and its scalp; one undo step

file.save.label: Save to Groom File
file.save.tip: Write the groom to the groom file it is linked to (asked for when none), for the standalone app to open

file.saveAs.label: Save Groom File As...
file.saveAs.tip: Write the groom to a new groom file, the scalp's animation cached over the playback range, and link the groom to it: for groomlab-cli, the Arnold procedural and the standalone app

import.xgen.label: From XGen...
import.xgen.tip: The scene's XGen descriptions (Interactive Groom and Core) as GroomLab grooms: guides, density, modifiers as nodes, maps copied into the masks folder, and a report

import.yeti.label: From Yeti...
import.yeti.tip: The scene's Yeti graphs as GroomLab grooms, read without Yeti: the groom's strands as guides, painted attributes as guide layers, graph nodes as GroomLab nodes, textures copied into the masks folder, and a report

import.alembicCurves.label: Alembic Curves...
import.alembicCurves.tip: An Alembic file's curves as the selected groom's guides (an ImportCurves node rooted on the scalp); with a mesh selected and no groom, a groom is made on it first

add.feathers.label: Feathers...
add.feathers.tip: Feathers on the groom: a design (or an assortment) on scattered shafts, or one hand-placed feather per selected curve

add.braid.label: Braid on Curves...
add.braid.tip: The selected curves (drawn from the scalp) become braid paths: a Braid node braids the strands along them

add.cards.hero.label: Hero
add.cards.hero.tip: A Cards node before the output at the hero level of detail: 6 x 2 cards a clump with flyaways

add.cards.mid.label: Mid
add.cards.mid.tip: A Cards node before the output at the mid level of detail: 2 x 1 cards a clump

add.cards.low.label: Low
add.cards.low.tip: A Cards node before the output at the low level of detail: one flat card a clump

add.collider.label: Collider
add.collider.tip: The selected mesh (besides the groom) keeps the strands off it: a ColliderMesh and a Collide node before the output

add.wind.label: Wind
add.wind.tip: A Wind node before the output: strands bend in a wind that varies over space and time

add.jiggle.label: Jiggle
add.jiggle.tip: A Jiggle node before the output: strands lag behind the scalp's motion and settle

sim.add.label: Add Simulate Node
sim.add.tip: GroomLab's own hair simulation (every host's): a Simulate node between the guides and Interpolate; play the timeline to see it

sim.range.label: Simulate Range
sim.range.tip: Step the Simulate nodes over the playback range into their cache (scrubbing reads it); the main progress bar counts the frames, Esc stops

sim.bake.label: Bake Simulation
sim.bake.tip: Simulate the playback range and write the Simulate nodes' frames to the scene's caches folder: renders, exports and groom files read the bake

sim.clear.label: Clear Simulation
sim.clear.tip: Drop the Simulate nodes' frames and bakes: the next frame shown simulates again

nhair.simulate.label: Simulate Guides (nHair)...
nhair.simulate.tip: Maya's nHair on one guide group; children follow the simulated guides

nhair.bake.label: Bake Simulation to Cache...
nhair.bake.tip: Run the nHair sim over the playback range, cache the guides and drop the live sim

nhair.remove.label: Remove Simulation
nhair.remove.tip: Drop the live nHair simulation and the guide cache

nhair.exportGuides.label: Export Guides for Simulation...
nhair.exportGuides.tip: A guide group as Alembic curves (strandId = guide ID), to simulate in another package

nhair.loadCache.label: Load Guide Cache...
nhair.loadCache.tip: Guide poses from an Alembic cache, by guide ID

review.heatmap.label: Density Heatmap
review.heatmap.tip: Color strands by root density: blue sparse, green typical, red bunched

review.hud.label: Strand Count HUD
review.hud.tip: The active groom's strand, render strand and guide counts in the viewport

review.turntable.label: Turntable
review.turntable.tip: A camera orbiting the groom over 120 frames, with a key, fill and rim light (the viewport looks through it)

render.turntable.label: Render Turntable...
render.turntable.tip: Render the groom going round in Arnold, in the background, for dailies

studio.preset.label: Studio Preset
studio.preset.tip: Studio lighting in Arnold: a backdrop, area lights and a camera round the groom

studio.lookThrough.label: Look Through Studio Camera
studio.lookThrough.tip: The viewport looks through groomlab_studio_cam (Panels > Perspective to go back)

studio.remove.label: Remove Studio
studio.remove.tip: Delete the studio; the head's material, the render settings and the playback range back as they were

render.fromGroomFile.label: Render from Groom File...
render.fromGroomFile.tip: Arnold renders the groom from a groom file at render time (small .ass files, farm renders); the scalp's animation is cached into it

render.asCurves.label: Render as Curves
render.asCurves.tip: Arnold renders the groom's strands from the scene as curves (the default; undoes Render from Groom File)

export.alembic.label: Alembic...
export.alembic.tip: The strands as Alembic curves over the playback range

export.usd.label: USD...
export.usd.tip: The strands as USD curves over the playback range

export.unrealGroom.label: Unreal Groom...
export.unrealGroom.tip: Alembic in Unreal's groom format: strands plus primary guides, at the current frame

export.unrealCards.label: Unreal Cards...
export.unrealCards.tip: The game cards as FBX with TGA maps in Unreal's hair card layout and a manifest, into a folder

export.unityStrands.label: Unity Strands (.abc)...
export.unityStrands.tip: Alembic curves for Unity's hair package: widths and root UVs per point, at the current frame

export.unityFeathers.label: Unity Feathers...
export.unityFeathers.tip: Feathers for Unity's hair package: barbs as strand groups, the rachis FBX to skin, and a manifest of the Hair Asset settings

export.unityCards.label: Unity Cards...
export.unityCards.tip: The game cards as FBX (meters, Y up) with PNG maps for HDRP/URP and a manifest

export.gltfCards.label: glTF Cards...
export.gltfCards.tip: The game cards as glTF 2.0 (.glb): PBR material, coverage as alpha mask, AO, hair cap

export.cardMaps.label: Card Maps...
export.cardMaps.tip: The card maps as an engine wants them: a preset (Unreal, Unity HDRP, every map on its own, your own packing), up to 8K, PNG, TGA, TIFF or EXR

export.scalesFbx.label: Scales Mesh (FBX)...
export.scalesFbx.tip: The scales bent onto the skin as one mesh for Unreal's static or skeletal mesh import, their data in uv and color sets

export.scalesUsd.label: Scales Instancer (USD)...
export.scalesUsd.tip: The scales as a USD PointInstancer of their plates: Unreal imports instanced static meshes (light, editable; the plates are not bent onto the skin)

guides.toCurves.label: Guides to Curves
guides.toCurves.tip: A NURBS curve per guide (the selected guides, else all), grouped by guide group and tagged with its guide ID, to edit with Maya's tools and bring back

guides.curvesToGuides.label: Curves to Guides...
guides.curvesToGuides.tip: Selected curves into the groom: curves from Guides to Curves reshape their guides in place (same IDs), any other curve becomes a new guide

strands.toCurves.label: Strands to Curves...
strands.toCurves.tip: The groom's (or a node's) strands as Maya curves, up to a cap, with width and channels as attributes

strands.toMesh.label: Strands to Mesh...
strands.toMesh.tip: The strands as one polygon mesh: tubes, or ribbons lying along the scalp, with UVs root to tip

node.bakeToGuides.label: Bake Node to Guides...
node.bakeToGuides.tip: A graph node's strands or guides (ToGuides, a Scatter...) become guides you can brush

scales.bakeMaps.label: Bake Scale Maps
scales.bakeMaps.tip: The scales baked into the skin's uvs as normal, height and color maps (PNG, UDIM tiles too), in the groom's bake folder: distant or tiny scales without their geometry

groom.transfer.label: Transfer Groom to Scalp...
groom.transfer.tip: Move the groom onto another mesh (a new sculpt, a retopologized head, another character): guides, parts and flow re-rooted

graph.copyToGrooms.label: Copy Graph to Other Grooms...
graph.copyToGrooms.tip: The active groom's graph (its look) onto the other selected grooms; their guides kept or replaced

files.findMissing.label: Find Missing Files...
files.findMissing.tip: Relink the selected grooms' (else every groom's) missing texture maps, images, Alembic files and caches to files of the same name in a folder you pick

theme.set.label: Theme
theme.set.tip: Restyle GroomLab with the {label} theme (remembered across sessions)

theme.new.label: New Theme from Current...
theme.new.tip: A copy of the active theme in your themes folder, to edit

theme.reload.label: Reload Theme
theme.reload.tip: Read the active theme's file again, after editing it

hotkeys.install.label: Install GroomLab Hotkeys
hotkeys.install.tip: A GroomLab hotkey set (a copy of yours): Y + click the marking menu, Page Up/Down the level, B/M + drag the radius/strength, Alt+Shift+X symmetry. Lists what it changes

help.docs.label: Docs
help.docs.tip: The docs at getgroomlab.com/docs (the folder shipped with the plugin without a browser)

help.shortcuts.label: Keyboard Shortcuts
help.shortcuts.tip: The brush and Graph Editor keys

help.updates.label: Check for Updates...
help.updates.tip: This version and the newest one with what's new; update in place (restart Maya to finish)

help.discord.label: Discord
help.discord.tip: The GroomLab community: questions, work in progress, feedback

help.donate.label: Support GroomLab
help.donate.tip: GroomLab is free for any use: support it with a donation at {donateUrl}

help.about.label: About GroomLab
help.about.tip: The version and where the plugin lives

group.new.label: New Group...
group.new.tip: New group (top-level, or a child group of another)

group.rename.label: Rename
group.rename.tip: Rename the group (or double-click its name); graph params naming it follow

group.color.label: Color...
group.color.tip: The group's color in the viewport

group.defaultColor.label: Default Color
group.defaultColor.tip: The group's color back to its level's

group.delete.label: Delete
group.delete.tip: Delete the group, its child groups and their guides

group.promoteDemote.label: Promote / Demote...
group.promoteDemote.tip: Move a group one level up, or down under a sibling group

guides.children.label: Children
guides.children.tip: Generate children for the selected guides (or the picked group): the count beside Edit Guides

guides.syncPos.label: Sync +X → -X
guides.syncPos.tip: Copy every guide on the +X side, children and edits included, over the -X side

guides.syncNeg.label: Sync -X → +X
guides.syncNeg.tip: Copy every guide on the -X side over the +X side

guides.mirrorSelection.label: Mirror Selection
guides.mirrorSelection.tip: Select the mirror images of the selected guides

guides.mirrorGroup.label: Mirror Group...
guides.mirrorGroup.tip: Copy a root group from one side to the other

guides.reparent.label: Reparent...
guides.reparent.tip: Move the selected children under another parent

guides.fromCurves.label: From Curves
guides.fromCurves.tip: Add the selected Maya curves as primary guides

parts.fromCurves.label: From Curves
parts.fromCurves.tip: Add the selected Maya curves as parts

map.new.label: New Map...
map.new.tip: A new map: on the guides, on the scalp's vertices, or a texture; blank, or for a setting (Density, Width, Length...: made, linked and painted at once; Ctrl on Density removes hair)

map.import.label: Import Image as Map...
map.import.tip: A new texture map from an image (named after the file; a JPEG, TGA, PSD... is copied into the masks folder as a PNG; color or gray as the image is)

map.rename.label: Rename...
map.rename.tip: Rename the map; Map nodes and params reading it follow

map.convert.label: Convert to
map.convert.tip: Convert to another kind: its name, and what reads it, stay the same

map.relink.label: Relink Image...
map.relink.tip: Point the map at another image: a PNG is used in place (painting edits it); a JPEG, TGA, PSD... is copied into the masks folder as a PNG

map.reloadImage.label: Reload Image
map.reloadImage.tip: Read the image again after editing it outside Maya

map.showFile.label: Show in Explorer
map.showFile.tip: Open the image's folder in the file browser

map.delete.label: Delete
map.delete.tip: Delete the map (a texture map's file too, unless Delete Its File is off in the list's right-click menu)

map.deleteFiles.label: Delete Its File Too
map.deleteFiles.tip: Deleting a texture map deletes its image from the masks folder too (undo puts it back). A PNG of yours linked in place, or one another map reads, stays.

corrective.new.label: New Corrective
corrective.new.tip: New corrective on every frame (unkeyed weight 1)

corrective.fixFrame.label: Fix Frame
corrective.fixFrame.tip: A corrective on this frame, keyed to blend in over the 6 frames before and out over the 6 after (drag the keys in the timeline to change that)

corrective.solo.label: Solo
corrective.solo.tip: Solo: only this corrective on (again: all on)

corrective.delete.label: Delete
corrective.delete.tip: Delete the corrective and its keys

corrective.goTo.label: Go to Its Frame
corrective.goTo.tip: The time slider to the corrective's frame

corrective.keyWeight.label: Key Weight Here
corrective.keyWeight.tip: Key the weight on this frame

corrective.clearKeys.label: Clear Keys (every frame)
corrective.clearKeys.tip: Delete the weight's keys: the corrective on every frame

corrective.rename.label: Rename
corrective.rename.tip: Rename the corrective (or double-click its name)

sculpt.clearEdits.label: Clear Sculpt Edits
sculpt.clearEdits.tip: Drop every stroke kept in this node: its guides as it is fed them (one undo step)

photo.import.label: Import Photo...
photo.import.tip: A photo as a camera: copied into the scene's groomlab/<scene>/references folder, aimed at the groom

photo.lookThrough.label: Look Through
photo.lookThrough.tip: Show the photo's camera in the viewport

photo.remove.label: Remove
photo.remove.tip: Remove the reference camera (its photo file stays on disk)

photo.addView.label: Add Camera
photo.addView.tip: Add View from Camera: a camera that already shows a photo on an image plane becomes a reference

pairs.solve.label: Solve
pairs.solve.tip: Line the camera up with the pairs: its position, rotation and focal length

pairs.repickPhoto.label: Pick the Photo Point Again
pairs.repickPhoto.tip: Clear the pair's point on the photo, to pick it again

pairs.repickMesh.label: Pick the Mesh Point Again
pairs.repickMesh.tip: Clear the pair's point on the mesh, to pick it again

node.setOutput.label: Set as Output
node.setOutput.tip: The groom shows this node's strands

node.view.label: Focus: View Up to Here
node.view.tip: The viewport shows the groom up to this node

node.brushSculpt.label: Brush This Node's Guides
node.brushSculpt.tip: Brushes shape the guides this node hands on; each stroke is kept in the node and follows the guides when what feeds it changes (off: the base groom)

node.bake.label: Bake Node to Guides...
node.bake.tip: This node's strands (or guides) as they are now become guides you can brush (GroomLab > Utilities > Bake Node to Guides)

node.expose.label: Expose Param as Input
node.expose.tip: The param as an input port

node.update.label: Update Node (version {latest})
node.update.tip: Take the library's newer copy of this node (its values kept where it still has them; one undo step)

script.edit.label: Edit Node...
script.edit.tip: Edit this script node in the side panel: its script, params and header, live

script.saveToLibrary.label: Save to Library
script.saveToLibrary.tip: Write this script node to your node library (its file, one version up when the library has it)

compound.ungroup.label: Ungroup Compound  (Ctrl+Shift+G)
compound.ungroup.tip: Put this compound's nodes back in the graph, to see and edit them (Ctrl+Z groups them again)

compound.showInner.label: Show Inner Param
compound.showInner.tip: The inner node's param on the compound

compound.saveAsNode.label: Save as Node...
compound.saveAsNode.tip: Save this compound to your node library: it shows in Add Node and Tab search, in every groom and in the standalone app and Blender

compound.saveToLibrary.label: Save to Library
compound.saveToLibrary.tip: Write this node as it is now (its values as the new defaults) over its library file, one version up

compound.groupSelection.label: Group Selection into Compound  (Ctrl+G)
compound.groupSelection.tip: Collapse the selected nodes into one Compound node

backdrop.add.label: Add Backdrop Around Selection
backdrop.add.tip: A labelled frame behind the selected nodes

graph.frame.label: Frame Selection
graph.frame.tip: Fit the selected nodes in the view, or the whole graph when none is selected

graph.frameAll.label: Frame All
graph.frameAll.tip: Fit the whole graph in the view

graph.group.label: Group into Compound
graph.group.tip: Collapse the selected nodes into a Compound node

graph.ungroup.label: Ungroup Compound
graph.ungroup.tip: Put the selected Compound nodes' nodes back in the graph, to see and edit them

graph.copy.label: Copy Graph
graph.copy.tip: Put this groom's whole graph on the clipboard as text (a preset with the control values), to share in a chat or forum or save as a .json preset

graph.paste.label: Paste Graph
graph.paste.tip: Replace this groom's graph with one copied as text (Copy Graph, or a preset's JSON), sizes fitted to this scalp: one undo step. The status bar says what it reads that this groom lacks

graph.gpuPreview.label: Preview Drags on the GPU
graph.gpuPreview.tip: Dragging a value of Interpolate (radius), Length, Clump, Noise, Curl or Width, and brushing guides, draws on the graphics card without evaluating (the release evaluates as ever); off: every drag and dab evaluates

node.newScript.label: New Script Node
node.newScript.tip: A node of your own, written as a short script (per strand, per point): it opens in the side panel to edit, live; Save to Library shares it with every groom, the standalone app and Blender

node.import.label: Import Node...
node.import.tip: Copy a .glnode file (a compound node someone shared) into your node library and add it (or drop the file on the graph)

node.openFolder.label: Open Nodes Folder
node.openFolder.tip: Your node library's folder (Documents/GroomLab/nodes): the standalone app and Blender read it too

preset.apply.label: Apply
preset.apply.tip: Replace this groom's graph with the preset, sizes fitted to this scalp, the maps it reads made: one undo step

preset.insert.label: Insert After Selected Node
preset.insert.tip: Keep this graph and add the preset's look to it as one Compound after the selected node (before the Output when none is selected), fitted to this scalp: one undo step

param.setKey.label: Set Key
param.setKey.tip: Key this param at the current frame: it becomes a keyable attribute on the groom (Maya: S over it, its curve in Maya's Graph Editor; Blender: the scalp's ctl_ property)

param.removeAnimation.label: Remove Animation
param.removeAnimation.tip: Delete its keys and keep its value now as the param's own

param.selectAttribute.label: Select Attribute
param.selectAttribute.tip: Select the groom with this param's attribute in the Channel Box (Maya's Graph Editor shows its curve)

param.paintGuides.label: On Guides
param.paintGuides.tip: A layer on the guides: children inherit it, strands blend it, it survives a new scalp

param.paintVertices.label: On Scalp Vertices
param.paintVertices.tip: A value per vertex of the scalp mesh, kept with the groom in the scene

param.paintTexture.label: As Texture
param.paintTexture.tip: An image at the scalp's UVs in the scene's groomlab/masks folder: the finest detail, editable elsewhere, exportable

param.driveWithSlider.label: Drive with Slider
param.driveWithSlider.tip: A Control node: this param becomes a keyable attribute on the groom (channel box), e.g. to animate a Blend from dry to wet
